[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor, and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "The criteria driving the 4-point score are streaks (irregular, 1 point), pigmentation (diffuse irregular, 1 point), dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point), and regression_structures (blue areas, 1 point).",
  "Each of these minor criteria contributes 1 point, summing to 4 points.",
  "The major criteria pigment_network, blue_whitish_veil, and vascular_structures were all scored as absent or typical, contributing 0 points.",
  "On the image, look for irregular radial lines or pseudopods, which represent streaks.",
  "On the image, look for asymmetric blotches of pigment, which represent pigmentation.",
  "On the image, look for varied-size dots or globules, which represent dots_and_globules.",
  "On the image, look for blue peppering or scar-like areas, which represent regression_structures."
]
